checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One finished 16:9 image with both photos side by side
must.why: Both photos are present side by side, but the canvas is 640x384 (about 5:3), not 16:9.

must.item: Brown kitchen left, white kitchen right
must.why: Brown-cabinet kitchen is on the left and white renovated kitchen is on the right.
Both labels are spelled correctly, clear and fully visible, with dark backing boxes.

must.item: Both complete photos visible without stretching or content changes
must.why: Each photo is cropped to a tall panel, so the right side of both is lost. The before image loses the right sink and window, and the after image loses its left side. Content is also redrawn and shifted, and the cabinets and counters look re-rendered.

faults.what: Both photos are cropped or reframed, not shown complete. The before photo loses its right-hand sink and window, and the after photo loses part of its left side.
The AI redrew the photos, so the content and perspective differ from the originals. The user asked to keep them as they are.
The labels have dark boxes overlaid on the photos, which is slightly heavy.

summary: The output is a side-by-side with correct "Before" and "After" labels, but both photos are cropped and redrawn instead of kept whole, and the canvas is not true 16:9.
